Extract all resources (managed and child modules) def get_all_resources(module): resources = list(module.get('resources', [])) for child in module.get('child_modules', []): resources.extend(get_all_resources(child)) return resources all_resources = get_all_resources(state['values']['root_module']) # Find all subnets (managed) managed_subnets = {} for res in all_resources: if res['type'] == 'aws_subnet': sid = res['values']['id'] managed_subnets[sid] = { 'type': 'managed', 'vpc': res['values']['vpc_id'], 'az': res['values']['availability_zone'], 'region': res['values']['region'] } # Find default VPC subnets (from data source) default_subnets = {} for res in all_resources: if res['type'] == 'aws_subnets': for sid in res['values'].get('ids', []): default_subnets[sid] = { 'type': 'default_vpc', 'region': res['values']['region'] } # Find all subnets with network interfaces (via instances) subnets_with_eni = set() for res in all_resources: if res['type'] == 'aws_instance': subnet_id = res['values'].get('subnet_id') if subnet_id: subnets_with_eni.add(subnet_id) # Compile all subnets all_subnets = {**managed_subnets, **default_subnets} # Generate report print("SUBNETS IN YOUR AWS ESTATE") print("=" * 60) print() # Group by region regions = {} for subnet_id, subnet_info in all_subnets.items(): region = subnet_info['region'] if region not in regions: regions[region] = {'managed': [], 'default': [], 'empty': []} if subnet_id in subnets_with_eni: if subnet_info['type'] == 'managed': regions[region]['managed'].append(subnet_id) else: regions[region]['default'].append(subnet_id) else: regions[region]['empty'].append((subnet_id, subnet_info['type'])) # Print by region for region in sorted(regions.keys()): print(f"Region: {region}") print("-" * 60) for subnet_id in regions[region]['managed']: print(f" ✓ {subnet_id} (managed) - HAS NETWORK INTERFACES") for subnet_id in regions[region]['default']: print(f" ✓ {subnet_id} (default VPC) - HAS NETWORK INTERFACES") for subnet_id, stype in regions[region]['empty']: print(f" ✗ {subnet_id} ({stype}) - NO NETWORK INTERFACES") print() # Summary print("SUBNETS WITH NO NETWORK INTERFACES") print("=" * 60) empty_subnets = [] for subnet_id, subnet_info in all_subnets.items(): if subnet_id not in subnets_with_eni: empty_subnets.append((subnet_id, subnet_info['region'], subnet_info['type'])) if empty_subnets: for subnet_id, region, stype in sorted(empty_subnets): print(f" • {subnet_id} ({region}) - Type: {stype}") else: print(" None - All subnets have at least one network interface") PYEOF python3 /tmp/subnet_analysis.py
